labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync log: platform refused the campaign
labels.value: Campaign sync could not copy the appeal "{0}" to its Campaign: {1}

labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync log: linked campaign not found
labels.value: The Campaign linked to the appeal "{0}" was deleted or is not visible to you. If deleted, clear Campaign ID on the appeal to make a new Campaign. If it still exists, give the person saving the appeal access to it.

labels.shortDescription: Appeal save refused: Campaign ID is not one
labels.value: Campaign ID must be the record ID of a Campaign (18 characters, starting 701), or empty.

labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync page: org has no Campaigns
labels.value: This org has no Campaigns (Salesforce Platform licenses do not include them), so Campaign sync cannot run here.

labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync page: the setting is off
labels.value: Campaign sync is off. Switch on Copy appeals to Campaigns in the Giving section of BarnCRM Settings, then come back to sync your appeals.

labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync page: the setting is on
labels.value: Campaign sync is on. Saving an appeal creates or updates its Campaign.

labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync page: appeals with a Campaign
Campaign sync page: viewer cannot write Campaigns
labels.value: You cannot create and edit Campaigns, so appeals you save get no Campaign. That needs Campaign access and the Marketing User box on your user record, both in Setup.

labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync page: viewer cannot sync all
labels.value: Only someone with the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission can sync all appeals.

labels.shortDescription: Campaign sync page: sync all button

labels.value: Something went wrong on the Campaign sync page. The details are in the Error Log.
